properties.displayName: Web Application Firewall (WAF) should be enabled for Application Gateway
properties.description: Deploy Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) in front of public facing web applications for additional inspection of incoming traffic. Web Application Firewall (WAF) provides centralized protection of your web applications from common exploits and vulnerabilities such as SQL injections, Cross-Site Scripting, local and remote file executions. You can also restrict access to your web applications by countries, IP address ranges, and other http(s) parameters via custom rules.

properties.displayName: Network Watcher should be enabled
properties.description: Network Watcher is a regional service that enables you to monitor and diagnose conditions at a network scenario level in, to, and from Azure. Scenario level monitoring enables you to diagnose problems at an end to end network level view. It is required to have a network watcher resource group to be created in every region where a virtual network is present. An alert is enabled if a network watcher resource group is not available in a particular region.

properties.displayName: Selected hub Firewall Policies must explicitly enable DNS proxy
properties.description: Audits missing and false DNS proxy values on explicitly selected Firewall Policies. Unlike the upstream presence-only check, an explicit false value is noncompliant. Inheritance is not resolved.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation.
Required, nonempty Firewall Policy resource IDs whose approved DNS architecture requires explicit DNS proxy configuration.

properties.displayName: Selected hub VNets must enable DDoS protection with an approved plan
properties.description: Audits selected eligible hub virtual networks unless enableDdosProtection is true and the associated DDoS plan resource ID is approved. This custom rule has no upstream mutation details.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation.
Required eligible hub VNet IDs and approved DDoS Network Protection plan IDs. Neither list may be empty.

properties.displayName: Selected Premium Firewall Policies must explicitly enable approved IDPS mode
properties.description: Audits selected Firewall Policies if the policy is not Premium or its explicit intrusionDetection.mode is missing, Off, or outside the required accepted Alert/Deny modes. Uses the real intrusionDetection.mode alias, not the malformed reference rule.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation; the IDPS traffic mode is a separate configuration.

metadata.displayName: Approved Premium policies and IDPS modes
metadata.description: Required nonempty policy IDs and accepted IDPS modes. Accept Alert, Deny, or both according to approved inspection architecture.

properties.displayName: Connectivity resources must have the approved AMBA-style metric alert profile
properties.description: Audits selected Connectivity resources without a same-subscription enabled metric alert targeting that single resource, with exactly one static, dimension-free approved metric condition and the required action groups.

metadata.description: Read-only related-resource evaluation.
Supply one reviewed metric profile and nonempty target/type/action-group lists. Repeat the definition in an initiative for additional metrics. Alerts must be in each target's subscription.

properties.displayName: Management resources must have the approved AMBA-style metric alert profile
properties.description: Audits selected Platform Management resources for a same-subscription enabled single-resource, single-condition static metric alert with the exact required metric profile and action groups.

metadata.description: Read-only related-resource evaluation.
Required reviewed metric namespace, name, aggregation, operator, threshold, window, frequency, target resource IDs/types, and action-group IDs. Instantiate separately for each required metric.

properties.displayName: Identity platform Azure resources must have the approved metric alert profile
properties.description: Audits selected Azure resources in Platform Identity for enabled same-subscription, single-resource metric alerts with exactly one required static metric condition and required action groups. This does not evaluate Microsoft Entra tenant configuration.

metadata.description: Read-only related-resource evaluation.
Required approved Azure resource IDs/types and one complete metric/action-group profile. This is not a tenant-wide Entra, Conditional Access, or identity-risk control.

properties.displayName: Selected hub VNets must have enabled flow logs with approved storage and retention
properties.description: Audits selected hub VNets without a same-region, same-subscription Network Watcher flow log explicitly targeting the VNet, enabled, writing to approved storage, and using enabled finite retention at least the required minimum.

metadata.description: Read-only related-resource evaluation.
Supply nonempty approved hub VNet IDs and storage account IDs, plus the required finite minimum retention days. Regional Network Watcher resources may be in a different RG in the same subscription.
